training_population: Reuse PR75 persisted 439534 completed pre-cutoff GPU jobs; do not expand membership or refit ML. Recompute Q25 from their observed queue labels.
workload_class: PR75 frozen QoS-derived operational class only; no semantic model. Optional future semantic class is not consumed.

rules.T0_CURRENT: Reproduce frozen R0 gate and bounds as historical audit only; future V42 temporal options require finalized service provider.
rules.T1_COHORT_MEDIAN: PR75 R1 candidate: standby or supported nonprotected cohort median >=900s. Standby uses authorized service window; nonstandby median budget is not imposed by PR75 R1.
rules.T2_CONSERVATIVE_Q25: Standby retains scheduler candidate plus authorized service window. Other nonprotected cohorts require N>=100 and Q25>=900s; budget=floor(Q25/900) slots. No observed current-job queue label.

historical_validation: Inventory entire existing pre-May episode ledger 2024-03-15..2025-04-30. Preserve null executable masks if final service/native authority absent; no selection of only successful days.
historical_R0_reproduction: Read immutable PR75 published May audit tables only; no new May policy/evaluation run or tuning.
synthetic_scope: Ten A-J cases and bounded exact MILP; synthetic percentages never population estimates.
checkpoint: 1800s physical cadence, 900s control grid, ceil mapping; causal elapsed for carry-in; exact boundary included
prescreen: Hard infeasibility and exact duplicate removal only. No fixed-other-movable-job occupancy screen, topK, grid-benefit ranking or arbitrary dominance.
objective: rho=max critical LINE normalized load; transformer separate hard limit. Retain optional service/reserve shortfall before intervention. Lex migration, shift slots, initial-site changes, MESS movement, deterministic final tie.
epsilon_source: Inherited v42/blocks.py NO_REGRET_TOLERANCE=1e-7; synthetic solver comparison only, no production trust/epsilon change
